_comment: Commit Guardian — Legacy Template Configuration (templates/commit-guardian/). KEEP-STUB RATIONALE (M-1 investigation, 2026-07-08): This directory was removed by commit 21d341e3 (feat(build): remove deprecated templates/commit-guardian/ tree, PR #134) but was recreated as a parity-check stub by commit c76e1cf2 (feat(build_pipeline): add check_hook_parity.py pre-commit hook). The stub exists because check_hook_parity's check #2 (manifest parity) requires a legacy manifest to compare against the canonical one — without this stub, the legacy manifest path would be absent and the check would always skip, defeating its purpose. DO NOT DELETE this directory. DO NOT expand it into a full mirror of the canonical tree. Its sole purpose is to act as a parity target for check #2. See EPIC-Phase1ReadyHardening/04 for context.

hook_parity._comment: check_hook_parity.py — Parity enforcement across runtime dir, canonical template dir, legacy template dir, and deployed output dir. All paths are relative to the project root.

hooks_manifest._comment: Legacy manifest hooks array. Every hook ID here must also appear in the canonical manifest at templates/scripts/commit_guardian/commit_guardian.json. The parity check enforces this invariant on every commit.

hooks.name: Check Hook Parity (leafcutter)
hooks.description: Enforces parity of commit-guardian hook scripts and manifest entries across runtime, canonical template, legacy template, and deployed output dirs
hooks._comment: EPIC-Phase1ReadyHardening/04: Blocks commits when hook scripts or manifest entries are missing from any of the three tracked source dirs. Fail-open on I/O errors.

hooks.name: Check Output Drift (leafcutter Direction B)
hooks._comment: Direction B drift guard: blocks direct edits to built output files. Companion to check-build-drift (Direction A). Fires when any .claude/ or .agents/ output directory files are staged.

hooks.name: Check Ticket AC Status Parity (KI-1)
hooks._comment: KI-1 (BO-2200 retrospective): Blocks commits when a staged ticket has status:done but its source_ac is not yet work_status:done in the AC store.
